'''Microsurgery computers''' were a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that was used for medical purposes. [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]] produced microsurgery computers in associations with [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy]].<ref name="EGWT" />
